items.title: RustingStrata – Pure Rust LLM GGUF Engine, Runs Models > VRAM on CUDA and Vulkan
items.author: peter_d_sherman
items.snippet: A pure-Rust inference engine for GGUF models, built for MoE models that do not fit in VRAM. The CUDA kernels are compiled at run time with NVRTC, and the same kernels run on Vulkan: no C++ build step, no ggml. Experts that do not fit in VRAM run on the CPU at the same time as…

items.title: Flawrence – LLM-based vulnerability analysis for everyone

items.snippet: Flawrence finds security vulnerabilities in source code with LLM agents. It reads a codebase, builds a threat model, maps the attack surface and gives every entry point its own research agent. A second agent validates each candidate finding and tries to reproduce it. Only…
